title: List of Muppets
blurb: Gonzo the Great's on-again, off-again chicken girlfriend on The Muppet Show, usually appearing as part of his eccentric act.
facts: The majority of the characters listed here originated on The Muppet Show, a television series that aired from 1976 to 1981.
Since then, several more characters have been introduced in other television series, as well as theatrical films.
